title: How to prorate a monthly amount by days
task: Charge or pay a fair share of a monthly figure — mid-month move-ins, partial billing periods.

excel.note: A2=monthly amount, B2=any date in that month, C2=days occupied. DAY(EOMONTH(...)) = days in that month.

explanation: EOMONTH finds the month's last day and DAY reads its number — 31 for July — giving a true daily rate that adapts to each month's length: $1,500 ÷ 31 × 10 days = $483.87. That's fairer than a fixed /30, which overcharges February and undercharges July. Some leases specify a flat 30-day convention instead — then the formula is simply A2/30*C2; match the contract, not the calendar.
